content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments represents a radical shift in how digital creators can monetize their work without relying on traditional payment platforms. Unlike services such as Gumroad, which charge as much as 10% per sale, using NOWPayments with COREMERCH reduces fees to a mere 0.5%. This means that for creators, the difference can be significant; for example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. This is not just about saving money; it’s about gaining sovereignty over your commerce without the dependency on platforms that may reject you.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH utilizes a decentralized architecture that leverages free and open-source tools to create a resilient digital commerce stack. By combining GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can manage their entire sales process independently. This approach ensures that creators own everything after deployment, from the content to the customer data, minimizing risks associated with platform lockouts and financial restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or severely limited. Whether you are a music producer selling beats, an educator offering online courses, or a designer selling templates, COREMERCH enables you to establish your commerce infrastructure. The focus is on creators who value ownership, control, and the ability to operate without restrictions imposed by conventional platforms, ensuring that they can thrive in the global digital economy.
Keep 99.5% of your sales with ultra-low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH stack consists of several key components that integrate seamlessly to facilitate online sales. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the backend. Supabase or Google Sheets are utilized for order storage, providing a simple yet effective way to manage customer data. File delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that purchases are delivered instantly. Finally, NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency transactions, allowing creators to accept various crypto assets with minimal fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the appropriate COREMERCH stack that fits your needs—either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, follow the deployment instructions provided in the documentation, making sure to configure your domain and payment settings correctly. Populate your digital store with your products, ensuring each item is ready for automated delivery. Finally, promote your store through your networks and begin accepting payments in cryptocurrency. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign digital commerce stack like COREMERCH. This setup allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, without hefty platform fees. By utilizing tools like NOWPayments, you can retain more from each sale, ensuring that your earnings are maximized without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Own your entire digital commerce stack, from hosting to payments.

Your Deployment Checklist

Select the appropriate COREMERCH stack for your needs. Configure your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Store your orders using Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Promote your digital store to your audience and start selling.

You can sell beats online by utilizing the COREMERCH infrastructure, which allows for direct sales through your own website. By setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can accept payments in cryptocurrency, bypassing the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.

NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This difference can save you a substantial amount in fees, particularly if you’re making multiple sales each month.

Yes, COREMERCH tools are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing website. You can host your site on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and add the necessary backend logic to handle payments and orders without disruption.

Absolutely. By using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can securely manage customer data without relying on third-party platforms. This ensures that you maintain full control and ownership of your data.
